features.name: opt__spot
features.description: Underlying spot price for the option chain snapshot.

features.name: opt__nearest_oi_call
features.description: Open interest of the nearest at-the-money call option.

features.name: opt__nearest_oi_put
features.description: Open interest of the nearest at-the-money put option.

features.name: opt__total_oi_calls
features.description: Total call open interest aggregated across strikes.

features.name: opt__total_oi_puts
features.description: Total put open interest aggregated across strikes.

features.name: opt__call_put_oi_ratio
features.description: Ratio of call open interest to total call plus put open interest.

features.name: opt__best_bid_iv
features.description: Implied volatility at best bid for the nearest maturity.

features.name: opt__best_ask_iv
features.description: Implied volatility at best ask for the nearest maturity.

features.name: opt__oi_change
features.description: Change in total open interest relative to the previous snapshot.

features.name: opt__iv_crush_detector
features.description: Flag indicating sudden compression in implied volatility levels.

features.name: opt__trade_size_by_moneyness_proxy
features.description: Trade size distribution weighted by a moneyness proxy.

features.name: opt__implied_vol_slope
features.description: Local slope of implied volatility across adjacent strikes.

features.name: opt__option_flow_imbalance
features.description: Signed option notional flow with calls positive and puts negative.
